title: facebookincubator/muse-gadget-sdk
why_read: An open-source hardware SDK from Meta for building wearable 'Muse' gadgets, relevant to engineers working on AR/wearable device ecosystems.
analysis: This SDK presumably lets developers build companion hardware or accessories for Meta's Muse smart glasses or similar wearable product line, written primarily in C suggesting embedded or firmware-level work. Open SDKs for wearable hardware are relatively rare and can meaningfully lower the barrier for third-party hardware experimentation. The actual technical scope (sensors, BLE, firmware APIs) isn't detailed here, so interest depends heavily on whether a reader works in wearables or embedded systems. It's a notable release from a major company's hardware division rather than a research contribution.
